items.title: Bernie Kirsh interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 27, 2022
items.q: I wanted to speak about this project that you’ve been involved with with Glenn Zottola.

ctx.x: I wanted to speak about this project that you’ve been involved with with Glenn Zottola. It’s wonderful that Chick’s legacy is continuing. And some of these recordings are really marvelous and it’s nice that Glenn was there when Chick wanted to reach out. And apparently Chick would call him up very late and say, “What are you doing? Come on over.”

Yeah I know that was him. It’s playing, just total playing. And they would do that. Yeah I mean they play great — Glenn is just a marvelous musician, just incredible. And he and Chick got along so well that way. And you can hear it in that recording. So great camaraderie there.
It’s like you said right at the beginning of our interview, you just did it. Just let it happen. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
